notes: New tools and a lot more control in the 3D Livery tab. Tools: a Brush with 21 brushes, smudge, clone, left/right mirror painting, saved presets and Alt + right-drag sizing; a Text tool with every installed font and Photoshop-style options, plus text that follows a path at its real size; Gradient and bucket; Eyedropper (Alt + click works in the brush, text and gradient tools); Path and Path selection tools (draw an open or closed path, or copy a shape's path to edit, for text to follow). Layers: blend modes (Multiply, Screen, Overlay and more), groups (Ctrl+G), align and distribute, combine shapes (cut, overlap, merge), outline and shadow with a live preview, rename (F2), recent colours, and an Edit > History window to jump to any step. Also: corner handles for scaling, grid snap and a points toggle, and an F1 list of every shortcut with a search box.
